title: Prompting for images and video
intro: Two formulas, two power-ups, and a workflow where every output becomes the next step's input.

steps.title: The image formula
steps.body:
Six dimensions structure an image prompt: **subject** (who/what), **action** (life and movement), **location** (scene, background), **composition/camera** ('low-angle shot', 'shallow depth of field'), **lighting** ('cinematic lighting'), and **style** ('minimalistic vector art').

Keywords are scaffolding — for you, not the model.

steps.title: The two power-ups
steps.body:
1. **LLM-enhanced prompting** — the model's language understanding prefers **one rich descriptive paragraph** over a keyword list. Hand the keywords to an LLM and let it weave the paragraph: the LLM is your *director*.
2. **Reference image** — supply an image with the text as a **blueprint** for palette, texture, and feel → consistency and style.

steps.title: Video adds the time dimensions
steps.body: Veo's formula groups keywords in three: **main** (subject, action, scene = where *and when*, style, **temporal** — how the scene changes), **camera** (angle, **movement** — pan/tilt/static, lens effects), and **audio** (dialogue, sound effects — the video ships with native sound).

viz.title: What only exists once time does

points.label: Temporal
points.note: Pacing and flow — 'zoom reveals the diagram'. Stills don't change; videos must.

points.label: Camera motion
points.note: The frame itself moves: static, pan left/right, tilt up/down.

points.label: Audio
points.note: Dialogue and sound effects are part of the prompt — a ticking clock, key clicks, a spoken line.

steps.title: The compounding workflow
steps.body:
Basic prompt → structured keywords → LLM-woven paragraph → + reference image → generate → **save the output**. The saved image becomes the *video's first frame*, keeping the look consistent across lessons.

> [!tip] Video generation is a **long-running operation you poll** (~15s intervals) — asynchronous by nature. Design workflows around that, not around instant responses.

recap:
**Structure with keywords; generate from paragraphs; anchor with references.**

- Image: subject / action / location / camera / lighting / style.
- Video adds temporal, camera movement, and audio — the time dimensions.
- LLM-enhanced prompting: keywords → one rich paragraph.
- Reference image = style blueprint (stills) or first frame (video).
